gateway.scp_unleashed.destination.scp173: Beyond this gateway is a Foundation site in total containment failure: escaped anomalies, automated defences, memetic hazards and implied violence.
You keep what you carry. Something to bring you home will be waiting in your pocket when you arrive.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.reality_folder.1: The Reality Folder is a 5 wide, 6 tall machine. Fix an outlet to one of the copper power ports on its back and sides, and wire it to a power network.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.reality_folder.2: It needs a huge, steady supply to run: most of a fusion reactor's output. With too little power it will not start, and if the supply drops it shuts down hard.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.reality_folder.3: Once spun up it projects a wide anchoring field around itself.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scranton_reality_: Hold use to wind up, then release to throw. Where it lands, it bursts into a short-lived anchoring field.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp1730_contained: Given to anyone who arrives at Site-13. Using it there takes you back to where you came from.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.title: What Happened to Site-13
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.caption: Recovered security still of a Site-13 corridor. The markings on the far wall were not present when the camera was installed.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.0.text.0: SCP-1730 cannot be contained in the conventional sense. Its only known point of access is a shard attuned to Site-13, seated in a powered Contained Gateway. Entry is restricted to volunteer teams with Level 4 clearance.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.0.text.1: Each entrant arrives carrying a contained fragment. Teams are to account for theirs at all times. Personnel are reminded that equipment taken into Site-13 is not guaranteed to come back.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.0.text.2: **Personnel present while Site-13 is failing are not to be readmitted under any circumstances.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.1.text.0: SCP-1730 is Site-13, a Foundation facility lost during an incident in %r[DATA EXPUNGED]%r and re-encountered ever since. The site is found in a state of total containment failure: cells open, doors torn from their frames, and its automated defences still running on whatever power remains.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.1.text.1: The layout of Site-13 is never the same twice. It descends. Entrance offices give way to light and then heavy containment, and below those to levels no surviving blueprint describes.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.2.title: Addendum 1730-1: The Painter
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.2.text.0: A tall, cloaked figure in a wide hat, designated SCP-1730-1, has been sighted on every expedition. It does not approach entrants. It paints.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.2.text.1: Entrants who stopped to study its work have not returned. %rTwo recovered helmet cameras show the wearer standing perfectly still until the feed ends.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.3.title: Addendum 1730-2: Malidramagiuan
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.3.text.0: At the lowest level reached, a device designated the Thresher is attended by SCP-1730-2, named Malidramagiuan in recovered Site-13 records.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.3.text.1: Conventional weapons pass through it as if it were not entirely there. Teams that entered its chamber unprepared were lost within seconds.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.4.title: Addendum 1730-3 and 1730-4
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.4.text.0: Black fissures in the walls of Site-13 are attributed to SCP-1730-3, an entity never observed in full. Small organisms emerge from them. Occasionally, something much larger reaches out.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.4.text.1: SCP-1730-4 is a pit in the heavy containment wing, ringed in red. Nothing that has gone into it has been heard to land.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.5.title: Addendum 1730-5: Recovery
dossier.scp_unleashed.1730.page.5.text: Shards attuned to Site-13 are delivered to readers of this file. See field notes.
